name: Dialogs For All!
description: Opens any internal link in an AJAX dialog, modal, or off-canvas tray by adding magic "dialog" query-string parameters.
project_description: Dialogs For All! lets any internal link open in a Drupal AJAX dialog by adding a magic "dialog" query parameter to the link. It implements hook_link_alter() and rewrites the matching link into a use-ajax link carrying data-dialog-type / data-dialog-renderer / data-dialog-options attributes, attaching core/drupal.dialog.ajax and any requested jQuery UI effect libraries. Supports basic (?dialog=modal), nested (?dialog[type]=modal&dialog[renderer]=off_canvas), and options/effects/libraries syntaxes; the dialog query parameters are stripped from the final rendered URL. No configuration UI, routes, permissions, or config schema.
